note: World series: dated open-source counts for the World part's By the numbers row and the Wednesday trend line. The morning run appends one row per published value; cadence is per series. Keys in money series.json (brent, ttf) can also be referenced from the edition.

ua-air.label: Drones and missiles launched at Ukraine overnight
ua-air.source: Ukrainian Air Force daily statement, as reported by Ukrinform or the Kyiv Independent

ru-personnel-day.label: Russian personnel losses claimed per day
ru-personnel-day.source: Ukrainian General Staff daily figure via index.minfin.com.ua

ru-uav-day.label: Russian UAVs claimed destroyed per day
ru-uav-day.source: Ukrainian General Staff daily figure via index.minfin.com.ua

hormuz-transits.label: Non-Iranian-linked transits of Hormuz per week
hormuz-transits.source: Lloyd's List Intelligence, Strait of Hormuz Brief
hormuz-transits.note: Rows dated by the Monday that starts the week counted. First published values from the 5 Nov 2026 brief: 12–18 Oct and 19–25 Oct.

ua-strikes-week.label: Ukrainian long-range strikes claimed per week

ua-drones-month.label: Shahed-type drones launched at Ukraine per month
ua-drones-month.source: Institute for Science and International Security, monthly analysis of Ukrainian Air Force reports (Table 1a, all Shahed-type drones including decoys)
ua-drones-month.note: Rows dated the first of the month. September 2026 is the institute's reporting baseline (6,732); it estimates the full month at 7,400–7,700. October not yet published by the institute.

bab-transits-month.label: Bab el-Mandeb Strait: vessel transits per month
bab-transits-month.source: IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint data (n_total), summed by calendar month by the morning run
bab-transits-month.note: Rows dated the first of the month. Monthly sums of PortWatch's daily modelled transit estimates (cargo plus tanker), retrieved 8 Nov 2026 from the PortWatch ArcGIS layer; PortWatch can revise daily values. October 2023, before the Houthi campaign, had 2,438 transits.
